**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

Contrary to the planner's expectation that this rule was likely absent, Section 4.2 contains a Customer-payable liquidated termination amount:

- **The trigger:** any termination by the Company, including exercise of the ordinary 90-day non-renewal right in Section 4.1, and (other than the narrow Section 1.6 launch-failure carve-out) even termination for HDI's own default.
- **The amount:** (trailing 12-month Net Sales − $800,000) ÷ 2 — measured against *gross revenue*, not fees, and uncapped. Since our fees are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, at $2M annual Net Sales the payment would be ~$600,000 against ~$140,000 of three months' fees. That is roughly 4x the playbook's fallback ceiling, so it fails the fallback on a material term.

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** delete Section 4.2(a)–(c) and its heading, and conform the Section 4 heading to "Term; Termination." The comment flags the three-month fee cap (per precedent seed-ld) as our fallback if HDI insists an early-termination fee is part of the revenue-share economics.
